title: Chegada — foco no Tiro e progressão de acabamento
direction: Correção do Vitor: poucos objetos para preservar a presença do cachorro. Comum simples; Brilhante com acabamento moderado; Rara com iluminação melhor e mais detalhe; última com texturas finas, sem encher a cena.
objects_policy: Mesmos objetos da foto-base nas quatro versões; nenhum adereço novo.

variants.label: Comum
variants.detail: COMMON / 1: very simple and clean. Use broad calm shapes and smooth color areas for the wall, plant, floor and red/cream rug; a plain frame and simple window, minimal natural texture on box and blanket. Soft even natural warm daylight, gentle contrast, no dramatic rays. Puppy remains carefully drawn and expressive but with restrained fur texture. Keep only the exact base objects listed, no extras. The image should feel lovely and complete despite its simplicity.
variants.prompt: Edit the supplied Tiro Adventure 'Chegada' photo into ONE version for a carefully restrained four-rarity progression. CRITICAL ART DIRECTION: THE LITTLE DOG MUST REMAIN THE UNDISPUTED HERO. Higher rarity means better craftsmanship, texture and lighting, NOT more objects or visual clutter. Preserve exactly the base composition: tiny two-month-old baby Yorkshire in plain open cardboard box, two front paws on front flap, same head tilt and sweet brown eyes, FLOPPY ears, fluffy BLACK crown/back with tan muzzle eyebrows chest paws, cream blanket with red stripe over left flap. Same puppy size and camera, dog face strongly readable at thumbnail scale. Retain ONLY the objects already in base photo: box, blanket, small bone-shaped biscuit and red/cream rope ball at lower right, red/cream rug, left window, one right terracotta plant, little framed picture behind. Do not add any basket, shelf, bag, slippers, extra plant, plush toy, bowl, flowers, books, furniture or additional props. Same number and placement of things across all tiers. Keep foreground supporting objects small and less contrasty than dog. BACKGROUND MUST STAY SOFT AND UNOBTRUSIVE so detailed objects never compete with his face. Same warm 2D animation/storybook style, delicate clean dark contours, refined cel shading and silky fur tufts, not 3D or photorealism. No border, text, labels, UI, magic particles, glitter, sparkles, star glints, rainbow or holographic bands. Square full bleed illustration. The user explicitly rejected the cluttered previous experiment. COMMON / 1: very simple and clean. variants.label: Brilhante
variants.detail: SHINY / 2: a subtle step above common, keeping exact same objects and simple uncluttered composition. Give puppy a little more definition in individual fur tufts, slightly clearer eyes and paws, add soft woven blanket texture, subtle cardboard folds and restrained wood grain. Rug pattern very modest and low contrast. Light still gentle normal daytime, only modestly improved shading and volume. Background soft and simple. No gold halo, no glints, no extra props, no ornate decoration. This tier is pleasant moderate polish, less elaborate than rare.

variants.label: Rara
variants.detail: RARE / 3: improve the LIGHTING and selected fine details, while keeping exactly the same sparse objects. Beautiful coherent soft directional sunlight from the LEFT window shapes the puppy's face and fur with nuanced warm highlights and soft natural shadows, making his eyes and expression the strongest focal point. More refined silky tufts, realistic soft blanket weave, fine corrugation at cardboard flap edge, tasteful subtle red/cream rug stitching. Better depth and color separation than shiny, but restrained exposure and no glowing outline or bright gold effects. Soft-focus muted background, plant and wall never compete with puppy. No new items and no fancy ornamented pot or frame.

variants.label: Holográfica
variants.detail: TOP RARITY / 4, called HOLOGRAPHIC but here test TEXTURE REFINEMENT, not foil. Keep same sparse composition and objects as all other tiers. Concentrate the very finest beautiful craftsmanship ON THE PUPPY and near supporting materials: exceptionally nuanced silky black-and-tan fur strands in layered tufts, delicate ear fluff, warm brown eye depth, little paw pads/fur and nose texture, subtly detailed blanket fibers and stitching, believable fine cardboard surface and corrugated edge. Beautiful restrained cinematic soft window lighting with gentle warm/cool balance and soft bokeh atmosphere, puppy face brightest and highest local contrast. Rug and plant remain subdued, low contrast and softly simplified; avoid intricate repeating floral decoration. The backdrop is even more softly atmospheric to frame the dog. Highest rarity feels like a lovingly finished premium illustration, NOT a busier room. No extra objects, no busy patterns, no metallic frame, no iridescence, no glitter, no magic and no strong gold halo.
